text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: C'mon Teach, quit worryin'! I'll be back to normal before you know it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's with that heap of carrots? And there're veggies, meat, and fish piled up too!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student A
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm so hungry…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, I've gotcha! I can't hold back with all these ingredients in front of me!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text: That's the Hishiama I know! You're the best chef in all of Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Are the ingredients… moving?!

text_block_list.name: Ingredients
text_block_list.text: Veggie, veggie. Meeeaaat. Fish, fish, fish…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What the?! The ingredients have merged together into a monster!

text_block_list.name: Food Monster
text_block_list.text: Graaah! Foooood!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student A
text_block_list.text: Oh, nooo. We're going to get eaten whole!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Like I'll let myself be eaten by some kind of ridiculous food monster!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Taste my hammer of justice!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: HISHIAMAAA KICK!

text_block_list.name: Food Monster
text_block_list.text: Fooood?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crick, crick. Crumble…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: For a bunch of ingredients, you sure know how to cause trouble… Why don't you stew over that!

text_block_list.name: Miho Student B
text_block_list.text: Nice job, Hishiama! You gave that monster a taste of its own medicine!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now, enjoy your full-course meal! If you've got any problems, you know who to call!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Hishiama Bike!

text_block_list.name: Hishiama Bike
text_block_list.text: Vroom, vroom!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? What was with that dream?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, well. Dunno why, but I'm feelin' great!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her pleasant dream, Hishi Amazon's fatigue is completely wiped away.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh? Where is that disgusting smell comin' from?! Someone leave garbage out or something?
I will haaave my reveeenge…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: A-A veggie ghost?! Please don't haunt me!

text_block_list.name: Moldy Carrot
text_block_list.text: I'm an old, rotten carrot, all mushy and dried up. You abandoned me in the back of the fridge…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Dang it! You completely slipped my mind!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I won't leave you behind again, so please forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It was just a dream… Man, I'm covered in sweat…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The nightmare leaves Hishi Amazon so rattled, she's unable to get any meaningful rest.
